disclaim_expertise: I am no physician, and you must not take counsel of me in such a matter.
You had far better ask a medical man than take my word for it.
I have not the skill to advise you there, and I will not pretend to it.
That is a question for a doctor, not for me.
I should be sorry to prescribe for you; I know nothing of the art.
Such advice as I could give you would be worth very little -- see a surgeon.
It is not my province, and I should do you harm by guessing at it.
Ask one who has studied these things. I have not.
